# Change to Bulky Waste Collection Requests

Minato City Waste Reduction Office

Published: Monday, October 5, 2026

From Monday, November 2, 2026, bulky waste collection must be requested by phone or online.

## What changes

When you make a request, give your address and your name.

You can request collection of up to five items at a time.

You can cancel a request up to the day before collection.

Collection covers furniture, bedding and bicycles only.

Requests made the old way are accepted only from October 5, 2026 to October 30, 2026.

## Fee

The fee is $4 per item. Buy a disposal ticket at a shop in the city before the collection day.

Attach the ticket where it can be seen easily.

## How to request

Phone: 0120-123-456 (weekdays, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.)

Online: the request page on the Minato City website

## Contact

Minato City Waste Reduction Office, phone: 0120-123-456
